changeSet.author: MDonato
changeSet.sql:
begin declare @refId int; set @refId = -1; select @refId = ID from ReferenceItemType where Name = 'Criticality' and CreatedBy = 0;
if (@refId > -1) begin update FT set SortOrder = SortOrder + 1 from FieldType FT cross apply ( select count(*) as cnt from FieldType where Object = 'IssueType' and ObjectID = FT.ObjectID and Type = 'Lookup' and Name = 'Criticality' and LookupObjectType = 'ReferenceItem' and LookupObjectID = @refId ) a cross apply ( select count(*) as cnt from FieldType where Object = 'IssueType' and ObjectID = FT.ObjectID and SortOrder = 0 and Name != 'Criticality' ) b where FT.Object = 'IssueType' and a.cnt > 0 --if criticality field exists on this issue type and b.cnt > 0 --if there are other fields on this issue type with sort order = 0 and not exists (select 1 from FieldType where ID = FT.ID and Name = 'Criticality' and LookupObjectType = 'ReferenceItem' and LookupobjectID = @refId) end end
changeSet.rollback:
begin declare @refId int; set @refId = -1; select @refId = ID from ReferenceItemType where Name = 'Criticality' and CreatedBy = 0;
if (@refId > -1) begin update FT set SortOrder = SortOrder - 1 from FieldType FT cross apply ( select count(*) as cnt from FieldType where Object = 'IssueType' and ObjectID = FT.ObjectID and Type = 'Lookup' and Name = 'Criticality' and LookupObjectType = 'ReferenceItem' and LookupObjectID = @refId ) a cross apply ( select count(*) as cnt from FieldType where Object = 'IssueType' and ObjectID = FT.ObjectID and SortOrder = 1 and Name != 'Criticality' ) b where FT.Object = 'IssueType' and a.cnt > 0 --if criticality field exists on this issue type and b.cnt > 0 --if there are other fields on this issue type with sort order = 1 and not exists (select 1 from FieldType where ID = FT.ID and Name = 'Criticality' and LookupObjectType = 'ReferenceItem' and LookupobjectID = @refId) end end
